reserves.name: Canadian-dollar cash deposits at ATB Financial

reserveReview.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 reserve batch 7

sources.label: Loon CADC transparency and monthly attestations

reserveReview.rationale: Loon's current transparency page states that every CADC is backed 1:1 by Canadian dollars at ATB Financial, with 100% cash deposits in segregated accounts and no exposure to commercial paper or investment instruments. The page lists a June 2026 monthly bank attestation, so the single disclosed cash-deposit slice remains the complete reserve composition.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Loon transparency page and listed June 2026 monthly bank attestation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The reserve asset class and ATB Financial custody are disclosed; the transparency page does not disclose account-level balances or provider shares beyond the single named bank.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Loon's monthly third-party attestation confirms Canadian-dollar cash held one-to-one in segregated ATB Financial accounts in trust for CADC holders; the trust structure supports bankruptcy remoteness, but account-level terms and any reuse permissions are not published.
